heading: EVENT DISCOVERY METADATA:
These independent facts may overlap and do not replace the event category.

For boolean flags, use true only when the source establishes the fact, false when it explicitly rules it out, and null when evidence is missing or uncertain. Never guess from the category, host, or the word 'free' alone.

fields.competition: An event where participants compete for rankings, judging, prizes or a winner, including hackathons, case competitions, contests and tournaments. Classify this individual event, not other events mentioned in a shared caption. Practice sessions, ordinary workshops, application announcements, raffles, ticket giveaways, watch parties and award ceremonies without competitive presentations do not qualify. Use null when competition is unconfirmed.
fields.employers_on_campus: Networking opportunities: true when meeting people who can help students' careers is part of this event. That covers employers, companies, firms or industry organizations recruiting, presenting, hosting, co-hosting or sponsoring it (a company named as host or co-host, such as "Ramp x Blueprint" or "Figma x Sanrio", qualifies even for a social); career fairs, employer information sessions and co-op or internship sessions; professionals or alumni sharing their careers or networking with students; career-path panels and advice sessions on breaking into an industry, including ones led by upper-year students; hackathons, designathons, datathons, case competitions and pitch competitions; and professional, industry or academic conferences, symposiums and summits. Online events and events off campus qualify. Ordinary club socials, meetings and workshops with no company, professional or career element, language and gift exchanges, study-abroad, exchange-program and grad school information, wellness, cultural, religious and community-service events, food distributions and performances do not qualify. Require event-specific evidence in the caption or poster; a post with no event details, such as a link-in-bio or weekly roundup post, establishes nothing. Classify this individual event, not other events in a shared caption. Use false when the event clearly has no networking element and null when that is uncertain.
fields.sports_game: An actual scheduled athletic game, match, meet, or tournament involving an official school varsity team. Intramural, club-team, and recreational competitions, practices, tryouts, fitness classes, sports-club meetings, video games, and watch parties do not qualify. School affiliation or posting from an athletics account alone does not establish varsity participation. Use null when official varsity participation is unconfirmed.
fields.campus_season_ids: School-configured campus season IDs established by the event's theme or purpose. Null means unreviewed or uncertain; an empty array means reviewed with no matching season. Display windows control filter visibility, not classification. Event dates alone do not prove thematic membership.
